description: This Java source file defines a Spring Security configuration class that disables security restrictions for the h2-console, allowing unrestricted access and disabling CSRF and frame options to support the embedded database console.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: A Spring Security configuration class that permits all access to the root context and the h2-console, while disabling CSRF protection and frame options to facilitate h2-console accessibility.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default configuration to set security rules that permit all access to '/' and '/h2-console/**'; disables CSRF and frame options.
